Chosen over making commit-task-work stage the index row: the index is shared by every phase, so a task commit carrying it carries other phases' rows, and the repo already commits the index on its own commit (chore(audit-index)); that file is also outside this task's files. Second symptom: tree_holds_only_integrated gains followers=() and skips those paths; the integration mark now holds {'regate', 'followers': [paths]} and retire_member passes them, so a member whose only differing byte is a follower the integration took (its phase-tree copy is the owner's recipe over the phase tree, moved by a merged sibling) is removed, not kept. test_drive_phase.py: fm fixture factored into _drive_follower_map(M, prefix, sharded=False); new fi-block (_follower_index_cases, sharded layout, the tests.add clause as title) and fr-block (_follower_retire_cases: fr1 follower skipped, fr2 DENY non-follower still differs, fr3 retire_member hands the mark's followers to the check); wt8m mutant lambda takes followers.
